title: Service Contracts: lanes, customer roles, credit approval and portfolio size by tier
content:
## Scope
This admission matrix belongs to the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product. For each tier it lists the trade lanes the tier may be written on, the customer roles that may hold it, whether the customer must be credit approved, and the lane count and total portfolio commitment the customer's live contracts must reach.

## Trade lanes by tier
| Trade lane | Starter | Standard | Regional Account | Key Account | Global Account | Strategic Partner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Asia-North Europe | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Asia-Mediterranean | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Transpacific Eastbound | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Asia-US East Coast | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Transatlantic Westbound | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Intra-Asia | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Asia-Middle East/India | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Europe-South America East Coast | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

The AHL Starter Service Contract is open on four lanes only; the other five tiers are open on all eight lanes.

## Holder conditions by tier
| Tier | Customer roles that may hold it | Credit approval required | Distinct lanes with live contracts, this one included | Total commitment of live contracts, this one included (FEU) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | no | 1 | 0 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | no | 1 | 0 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | yes | 1 | 0 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | yes | 1 | 0 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | yes | 3 | 4000 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | beneficial cargo owner only | yes | 4 | 10000 |

A lane figure of 1 and a portfolio figure of 0 are met by the contract itself, so in the first four tiers these two columns set no condition beyond the contract being offered.

## Quick questions
**May a freight forwarder or an NVOCC hold an AHL Strategic Partner Contract?** No; that tier lists the beneficial cargo owner role only.

**May an AHL Starter Service Contract be written on Asia-North Europe?** No; that lane is not among the Starter lanes.

**From which tier upward must the customer be credit approved?** From the AHL Regional Account Contract upward; the Starter and Standard tiers do not require it.
